text:
sam (CS): Heads-up: Aurora renewal is delayed — procurement insists on PO to Aurora Holdings (UK) and wants Net45. Onboarding says can't run paid workshops until invoices clear. Need quick alignment.

noah (AE): I can chase PO. Offered 9mo at 7% discount to keep deal moving; they prefer 12mo. Vendor code AH-UK-77. I'll ask for a CC fallback in case PO is slow.

claire (Legal): If invoice entity changes we need an addendum listing Aurora Holdings (UK) VAT 22-334455. Net45 is fine pending finance's revenue recognition review. Draft line: 

"Addendum: Seller will invoice Aurora Holdings (UK) (VAT 22-334455). Payment terms Net45 from invoice date. All other terms unchanged."

jord (Onboarding): Note: Workshops scheduled 2026-06-22. If payment not posted by 2026-06-18 we must postpone to 2026-06-29. We can still run a kickoff call.

sam (CS): I'll ask procurement to attach PO to DocuSign envelope. Noah, please forward PO when it arrives.

billing-bot: Provisional invoice IN-2026-4455 created (Net30). Flagged for manual update to Net45 after addendum.

noah (AE): PO received: PO# UK-443322. Uploaded to envelope. Sent CC fallback request; procurement prefers PO.

esign-bot: Envelope env-aurora-01 created by sam (CS). PO uploaded by noah (AE). Link: https://esign.example/env-aurora-01

claire (Legal): Countersigned addendum. sam please route signed addendum + PO to renewals@ and billing@.

billing-bot: Invoice updated to Net45 per approval. New ref IN-2026-4455-01. Accounting note: revenue recognition per addendum.

noah (AE): DocuSign completed, customer signed. Procurement confirmed payment will process within 4 business days.

jord (Onboarding): Holding workshop slot 2026-06-22 tentatively. Will confirm once payment posts.

sam (CS): Thanks team. I'll collect a short onboarding feedback pulse during week 1. Closing thread.
file_note: Renewal thread: PO to UK entity, Net30->Net45 request, addendum + DocuSign envelope, onboarding workshop hold and fallback plans.
